a.name: Numeral rail
a.description: An unboxed column on the bone page, one steel hairline from the text: thin display numerals 01 to 13 beside short names, the current numeral in a brass square.
a.differs_from: Thin numerals on the page itself, set off by one hairline, no photo and no panel; London's pick is a sunk panel headed by a photo, and the built dials carry no rule and no numeral scale.

b.name: Fact ledger
b.description: A raised deep-steel card: a readout naming the part you are reading, then tight rows each carrying its section's figure (6 questions, £500, 6 pups) as a pill.
b.differs_from: A raised dark card whose rows carry each section's own figure under a full-name readout; London's pick is a sunk light panel with a photo and a track, and the built dials are plain lists.

c.name: Page map
c.description: London's steel band drawing the page as blocks sized by word count; Manchester's three question blocks are dotted and marked with a question mark.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, motif: London struck every block with one ruled texture; Manchester's three question blocks are dotted and carry a question mark. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
